## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: review-complexity-classifier.sh reads review.size_upgrade_lines from dso-config.conf via read-config.sh, falling back to 300 when absent; verified by a test that sets the key and confirms the threshold changes.
- DD2: review-complexity-classifier.sh reads review.size_warn_lines from dso-config.conf via read-config.sh, falling back to 600 when absent; verified by a test.

## What to implement
Add two new test functions to tests/hooks/test-review-complexity-classifier.sh that fail (RED) until the config-driven implementation exists:

test_classifier_size_upgrade_threshold_from_config():
  Given: WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE points to a temp config containing review.size_upgrade_lines=150
  When: classifier runs with a 200-line diff (200 added lines; 200 < 300 default but >= 150 config value)
  Then: size_action == "upgrade"
  Note: With default threshold 300, a 200-line diff produces size_action="none". Config override to 150 should change it to "upgrade".

test_classifier_size_warn_threshold_from_config():
  Given: WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE points to a temp config containing review.size_warn_lines=400
  When: classifier runs with a 500-line diff (500 added lines; 500 < 600 default but >= 400 config value)
  Then: size_action == "warn"
  Note: With default threshold 600, a 500-line diff produces size_action="upgrade". Config override to 400 should change it to "warn".

Config isolation: Create a temp config file via mktemp in each test, write the key to it, set WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE, run classifier, then clean up.

Large diff creation: use printf '%s\n' with a loop to generate N unique added lines that each look like code (prefix "+code_line_NNN=...") so the classifier counts them as scorable added lines.

Both tests MUST add RED markers to .test-index before committing (see Acceptance Criteria).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | grep -E "PASS|FAIL" | tail -5
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] test_classifier_size_upgrade_threshold_from_config test function exists in tests/hooks/test-review-complexity-classifier.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'test_classifier_size_upgrade_threshold_from_config' tests/hooks/test-review-complexity-classifier.sh
- [ ] test_classifier_size_warn_threshold_from_config test function exists in tests/hooks/test-review-complexity-classifier.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'test_classifier_size_warn_threshold_from_config' tests/hooks/test-review-complexity-classifier.sh
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker [test_classifier_size_upgrade_threshold_from_config] for plugins/dso/scripts/review-complexity-classifier.sh
  Verify: grep '\[test_classifier_size_upgrade_threshold_from_config\]' "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index"
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker [test_classifier_size_warn_threshold_from_config] for plugins/dso/scripts/review-complexity-classifier.sh
  Verify: grep '\[test_classifier_size_warn_threshold_from_config\]' "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index"
- [ ] New tests fail before Task 2 implementation (confirms RED phase)
  Verify: WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE=/tmp/test.conf bash tests/hooks/test-review-complexity-classifier.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'FAIL\|Error'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
